The '''Sullustan Good Neighbor Act''' was a law in force at the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], which allowed [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]] on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], such as the [[Sullustan Constable Brigade]], to reward upstanding citizens who assisted [[Police officer/Legends|Peace Officers]] in their duties. Specifically, Amendment 102167 of the Act provided for direct payment for such assistance.
